nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User and developer documentation for the opencode GitHub Action: issue/PR workflows triggered by /opencode or /oc mentions, installation via `opencode github install`, manual workflow setup, and local development with MOCK_EVENT payload templates.

nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Composite GitHub Action definition exposing inputs (model, agent, share, prompt, use_github_token, mentions, variant, oidc_base_url) and steps that resolve the latest opencode release, cache ~/.opencode/bin, install the binary, and run `opencode github run`.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses runs.using: composite — inputs flow to the CLI as environment variables (MODEL, AGENT, SHARE, etc.) rather than through a Node.js action main entry; the action executes the released opencode binary instead of building from the repo.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the standalone GitHub Action entry (github/index.ts), declaring @actions/core, @actions/github, Octokit clients, and the workspace-pinned @opencode-ai/sdk dependency.
nodes.languageNotes: References @opencode-ai/sdk as workspace:* and @octokit/rest as catalog: even though github/ is excluded from the workspace config, so resolution depends on the monorepo's Bun install.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the standalone github action: ESNext target, bundler module resolution, react-jsx, noEmit, and strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess and noImplicitOverride.
